signal: Foursquare relaunched its Places product with an enhanced points-of-interest database and new developer API

email.subject1: pipeline for the new Places API
email.body1:
John, saw Foursquare relaunched Places with an enhanced POI database and a new developer API.

A platform relaunch usually opens far more in-market accounts than the sales team can actually cover, and that is where the early-mover deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Foursquare off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Foursquare.

When a flagship product relaunches, the number of accounts worth touching jumps faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to capitalize on the moment, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Foursquare needs to convert the Places momentum into closed revenue this quarter.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Foursquare.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Foursquare's reply rate likely compares to other data-platform companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority around the Places relaunch, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a relaunch quarter is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a developer-API motion? I'll tailor it to Foursquare either way.
